overview: Base class for all ZMUIToolkit buttons. A UIButton subclass that renders its background through a dedicated CALayer (backLayer) with automatic corner rounding and state-driven coloring (normal/selected/pressed/disabled), lays out an icon or an icon-above-single-line-title, exposes a rich set of @objc configuration setters (size, position, corner radius, background color, icon image/color/size, icon padding, text, text color, font size, font weight, accessibility, badge), and dispatches taps via onButtonClicked() -> buttonClickAction closure. It is a pure UIKit configuration component with no SDK lifecycle, no delegate registration, and no error codes; the only state machine is a VISUAL one over UIControl state and touch phase.

typeDefinitions.name: ZMUIToolkitIconBtn
typeDefinitions.notes: This class. @MainActor, @objc(ZMUIToolkitIconBtn). Base class for all toolkit buttons.

cases.name: iconOnly
cases.meaning: Normal-state title is empty/nil; icon centered.

cases.name: iconWithText
cases.meaning: Normal-state title non-empty; icon stacked above a single-line, center-aligned, tail-truncated title.

typeDefinitions.name: ZMUIToolkitIconBtnDescriptor
typeDefinitions.role: concrete ZMUIToolKitIconDescriptor used by the library

typeDefinitions.name: Badge
typeDefinitions.notes: Top-right badge view. Default fill #DA1639 (red), white text, fully rounded unless cornerRadius >= 0. Dot sizes: small 8x8, medium 12x12, large 16x16; otherwise a text-sized pill. Setting empty/nil text hides it.

typeDefinitions.name: customIconSize
typeDefinitions.notes: Custom icon size; nil uses intrinsic image size. Set via setIconSize.

typeDefinitions.name: customCornerRadius
typeDefinitions.notes: -1 = automatic. Set via setRadius. didSet triggers layout when changed.

typeDefinitions.name: buttonSize
typeDefinitions.notes: Backing _buttonSize; sanitized on set (non-finite -> 40, min 1). Returned by intrinsicContentSize.

typeDefinitions.name: textSpacing
typeDefinitions.notes: Spacing between icon and title. Sanitized (non-finite -> 0, negative -> 0). didSet updates title configuration and triggers layout.

prerequisites: Construct and use on the main thread (@MainActor).

Designated initializer takes a ZMUIToolKitIconDescriptor, which is an INTERNAL protocol; external callers generally construct a subclass that builds the descriptor internally rather than instantiating ZMUIToolkitIconBtn directly.

actions: load image named descriptor.iconname from the ZMUIToolkit bundle

finishInit: set _buttonSize, set normal image, center content, wire touchUpInside -> handleTouchUpInside -> onButtonClicked, add hidden badge subview, updateBadgeAppearance, register trait-change handler (iOS 17+), titleStateDidChange
apply descriptor backgroundColor, accessibilityLabel, iconPadding, iconColor, buttonClickAction
if bounds degenerate (0 width/height), reset bounds/frame to buttonSize (min 1)
on first run insert backLayer at index 0
compute corner radius (custom >= 0, else circular if max side <= 32, else rounded)
layout title (re-apply storedFontSize), layout image and title

exitPoints.note: No custom deinit; no SDK/delegate cleanup needed.

notSupportedInit.init?(coder:): Calls fatalError('init(coder:) has not been implemented'). Do not instantiate from Storyboard/XIB.

lifecycle.intrinsicContentSize: Returns buttonSize, so the button reports its configured size to Auto Layout / stack views.
lifecycle.delegateModel: None. This class defines no protocol/delegate callbacks; the only event hook is the click pipeline.

stateMachineNote: This is a VISUAL state machine over UIControl state + touch phase. It is NOT an SDK/feature state machine. There are no async transitions, no feature callbacks, and no error codes.

states.backLayerColor: slightly emphasized normal color; if the normal color is fully transparent, falls back to UIColor.systemGray5

stateTransitions.notes: Guarded by isEnabled; color change is non-animated via CATransaction setDisableActions(true).
Restoration scheduled 0.1s later via DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter calling updateBackgroundColor().
iOS 17+ via registerForTraitChanges; below 17 via traitCollectionDidChange. Both call updateBackgroundColor().

iconLayoutModes.iconOnly: Icon centered in content rect (after content insets). Active when normal-state title is empty/nil.
iconLayoutModes.iconWithText: Icon stacked above a single-line, center-aligned, tail-truncated title separated by textSpacing; group vertically centered. Active when normal-state title is non-empty.
iconLayoutModes.recomputedWhen: Title changes via setTitle/setAttributedTitle (.normal) or setButtonText.

logic: else if max(width,height) <= 32 -> cornerRadius = backLayer.height / 2 (fully circular)
cornerRadiusRule.after: layer.cornerRadius set to match backLayer.cornerRadius; clipsToBounds = true

apis.name: init(descriptor:)
apis.access: internal (parameter type ZMUIToolKitIconDescriptor is an internal protocol)
apis.description: Loads the icon asset named descriptor.iconname from the ZMUIToolkit bundle, sizes the button (descriptor frame size, or 40x40 if .zero), then applies background color, accessibility label, icon padding, icon color, and click callback from the descriptor.

apis.name: init(coder:)
apis.description: NOT SUPPORTED. Calls fatalError('init(coder:) has not been implemented'). Do not instantiate from Storyboard/XIB.

apis.name: onButtonClicked
apis.description: Invoked on touchUpInside (via handleTouchUpInside). Base implementation calls buttonClickAction(self). Override in subclasses for button-specific behavior; call super to still fire the closure.

apis.name: setBackgroundColor
apis.description: Sets the normal-state background color, stored in _customBackgroundColor and rendered through backLayer. The UIView.backgroundColor setter forces the real view background to nil.
notes: Disabled state shows systemGray4; pressed shows systemGray5; if never set, normal falls back to systemGray6.

apis.name: setRadius
apis.description: Sets an explicit corner radius (customCornerRadius). Value >= 0 overrides automatic circular/rounded behavior; -1 restores automatic rounding.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Corner radius in points, or -1 for automatic

apis.name: setSize
apis.description: Sets button width/height (buttonSize). Non-finite -> 40; each dimension clamped to >= 1. Updates intrinsicContentSize and triggers layout.

apis.name: setPosition
apis.signature: @objc public func setPosition(x: CGFloat, y: CGFloat)
apis.description: Sets frame.origin to (x, y). Meaningful only with manual (non-Auto-Layout) placement.

apis.name: setIconColor
apis.description: Sets icon tint by assigning tintColor and imageView.tintColor. Only affects template (tintable) images.

apis.name: setIcon
apis.description: Sets the normal-state image. Re-applies current tintColor to the image view, then setImage(_:for: .normal) (triggers layout).

apis.name: setIconSize
apis.description: Sets a custom icon size used during layout. Non-finite -> 0; clamped >= 0. If both width and height > 0 the custom size is applied (constrained to the content rect); otherwise the custom size is cleared and the icon uses its intrinsic image size.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Desired icon size, or .zero to use intrinsic size

apis.name: setIconPadding
apis.description: Sets uniform content insets (top/leading/bottom/trailing) around the icon/title content. Negative values clamped to 0.

apis.name: setAccessibility
apis.signature: @objc public func setAccessibility(label: String?, hint: String?)

apis.name: setButtonText
apis.description: Sets the normal-state title. Non-empty title switches to iconWithText layout; empty/nil switches back to iconOnly.

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: Text below the icon, or nil/empty to remove text

sideEffects: setTitle(.normal) -> titleStateDidChange() -> recomputes layout mode; setNeedsLayout()

apis.name: setTextColor
apis.description: Sets the title color for ALL control states (.normal, .highlighted, .selected, .disabled).

apis.name: setTextFontSize
apis.description: Sets the title font size. Stores the value (re-applied each layout via layoutTitleIfNeeded) and immediately sets titleLabel.font to systemFont(ofSize:).

apis.name: setTextSpacing
apis.description: Sets vertical spacing between icon and title (assigns textSpacing). Non-finite -> 0; negative clamped to 0.

parameters.name: spacing
parameters.description: Gap in points between icon and title

sideEffects: textSpacing didSet updates title configuration; setNeedsLayout()

apis.name: setFontSize
apis.description: Alias for setTextFontSize(_:). Behavior is identical.

apis.name: setFontWeight
apis.description: Sets the title font weight, preserving the current point size (defaults to 17.0 if no font set). Swift-only because UIFont.Weight is not Objective-C representable.

apis.name: setFontWeightRawValue
apis.description: Objective-C-friendly font-weight setter. Maps specific raw CGFloat values to UIFont.Weight and delegates to setFontWeight. Accepts these exact values: 0.0 ultraLight, 0.2 thin, 0.3 light, 0.4 regular, 0.5 medium, 0.6 semibold, 0.7 bold, 0.8 heavy, 1.0 black; other values use regular.

parameters.name: weightValue
parameters.description: One of 0.0 ultraLight, 0.2 thin, 0.3 light, 0.4 regular, 0.5 medium, 0.6 semibold, 0.7 bold, 0.8 heavy, 1.0 black; other values use regular

notes: Accepts the exact discrete values listed; other values use regular. Use the typed setFontWeight(_:) from Swift for arbitrary weights.

badgeProperties.name: badgeText
badgeProperties.effect: Badge text. Empty/nil hides the badge (per Badge.text behavior). Triggers layout.

badgeProperties.name: showBadgeBackground
badgeProperties.effect: true: rounded colored pill with default text inset (2,0) and an offset; false: transparent, zero corner radius/insets, flush at top-right.

badgeProperties.name: badgeBackgroundColor
badgeProperties.effect: Overrides badge fill color (applied only while showBadgeBackground is true).

badgeProperties.name: badgeWidth
badgeProperties.effect: Non-zero forces explicit badge width and scales the corner offset proportionally (3 * badgeWidth / 12). 0 uses intrinsic width and default 3.0 offset.

badgeLayout: Laid out at x = bounds.width - width + offset, y = -offset (when showBadgeBackground) so it overhangs the top-right corner. Default badge fill #DA1639 (red), white text.

overriddenUIKitMembers.behavior: Getter returns _customBackgroundColor; setter forces real background to nil and stores/renders through backLayer.
didSet forces imageView.alpha = 1.0 (prevents default highlight dimming of the icon).
super; for .normal also titleStateDidChange() to recompute icon/text layout mode.
Central layout pass; inserts backLayer, sizes it, computes corner radius, lays out icon/title and badge.
Pre-iOS-17 dark/light recolor path (deprecated on iOS 17+).

callbacks.name: clickPipeline
callbacks.description: The only event hook. buttonClickAction is a stored closure (ZMUIToolkitIconBtn) -> Void, default { _ in } (does nothing). Set from the descriptor at init or assignable directly (internal). Subclasses typically override onButtonClicked() rather than replacing the closure.

noProtocolCallbacks: ZMUIToolkitIconBtn defines no protocol/delegate callbacks. It is not SDK/session-aware.

inputValues.summary: This class performs no SDK calls and returns no error codes. The setters clamp and normalize their inputs to well-defined ranges.

perAction.valueHandling: Non-finite values use 40; each dimension clamped to a minimum of 1.
Non-finite values use 0; clamped to a minimum of 0; falls back to intrinsic size unless both dimensions > 0.
Non-finite values use 0; negative values use 0.
Values other than the listed ones use regular.
A bounds with 0 width or height is reset to buttonSize (minimum 1).

required: Construct and use on the main thread (@MainActor).
Subclasses overriding onButtonClicked() should call super.onButtonClicked() to still fire the buttonClickAction closure.
forbidden: Instantiating via init?(coder:) / Interface Builder (traps with fatalError).
Setting UIView.backgroundColor expecting a real view background; it is intercepted and rendered through backLayer (real layer background forced to nil).
recommended: Prefer the set* configuration methods over directly mutating UIKit properties so layout invalidation and the backLayer rendering path stay consistent.
Use the typed setFontWeight(_:) from Swift for arbitrary weights; setFontWeightRawValue only recognizes the exact discrete values.

examples.title: Subclass and override the click behavior
Configure size, icon, color, and corner radius
examples.code:
button.setSize(size: CGSize(width: 44, height: 44))
button.setIcon(icon: UIImage(named: "Mic")!)
button.setIconColor(color: .label)
button.setBackgroundColor(color: .systemGray6)
button.setRadius(radius: 8)        // explicit; pass -1 to restore automatic rounding
button.setIconPadding(padding: 8)

examples.title: Icon-with-text button
examples.code:
button.setIcon(icon: UIImage(named: "Participants")!)
button.setButtonText("Participants")   // switches to iconWithText layout
button.setTextFontSize(12)
button.setTextColor(.label)
button.setTextSpacing(4)
button.setFontWeightRawValue(0.6)      // semibold

examples.title: Show a count badge
examples.code:
button.badgeBackgroundColor = .systemRed
button.badgeTextColor = .white
button.badgeText = "12"
button.showBadge = true                 // badge becomes visible
// To hide:
button.showBadge = false

examples.title: Programmatic placement and accessibility
examples.code:
button.setPosition(x: 20, y: 100)       // only meaningful without Auto Layout
button.setAccessibility(label: "Mute", hint: "Mutes your microphone")

codeSnippets.name: nonAnimatedLayerColorChange
codeSnippets.description: Mutate CALayer properties without implicit animation (mirrors layerChangeWithoutAnimation).
codeSnippets.code:
CATransaction.begin()
CATransaction.setDisableActions(true)
// mutate CALayer properties here so they apply without implicit animation
CATransaction.commit()

codeSnippets.name: automaticCornerRadiusRule
codeSnippets.code:
let maxSide = max(button.bounds.width, button.bounds.height)
let radius = maxSide <= 32
    ? button.bounds.height / 2     // circular for small buttons
    : button.bounds.height / 4     // rounded for larger buttons

codeSnippets.name: objcRawFontWeight
codeSnippets.description: Map an Objective-C raw weight to UIFont.Weight (mirrors setFontWeightRawValue).
